releaseNotes: v1.0.0: Initial release. X2 is fully local and two-way over MQTT, with activities added automatically. X1S reports activities locally, with optional start/stop control through Sofabaton's cloud webhook. X2 requires Hubitat 2.5.2.126 or newer with the built-in MQTT broker enabled. After installing, open the app and follow Tips & Troubleshooting for your hub.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Sofabaton Integration
apps.description: Manages Sofabaton X2 and X1S hubs and creates their activity devices. Includes setup guides and status.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Integration Bridge
drivers.description: Internal bridge device. Holds the shared MQTT connection for X2 hubs and parents each hub. Not user-facing; created automatically by the app.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Remote
drivers.description: One per Sofabaton hub. Receives activity changes over MQTT (X2) or local HTTP (X1S). Created automatically by the app.

drivers.name: Sofabaton Activity
drivers.description: One per activity, as a switch for rules and dashboards. Created automatically for X2, added in the app for X1S.
